interview.name: Rey
interview.answer: I don’t have enough information to tell when or where the repair drive is being held.

reflections: Rey is coordinating the repair effort and relies on others to report needs or changes.
Oren is willing and cooperative, but he may need reminders and direct guidance to stay on track.
Ira is supportive and proactive about keeping watch while handling other tasks.
Rey is acting as the central coordinator, keeping multiple people informed and following up on details.
Ira and Hana are responsive supporters who wait for updates and help keep things moving.
Opal is taking on the organizing role, tracking logistics and keeping the shared list current.
Rey is the main coordinator, keeping multiple people updated and consolidating repair, timing, and drop-off details.
Hana, Opal, and Faye each take on a specific support role: confirming details, organizing logistics, and checking pickup timing.
The relationships are cooperative and task-focused, with clear handoffs and follow-up expectations between everyone involved.
Rey is coordinating repair and pickup logistics across multiple people and is consistently keeping others updated.
Faye and Dane are responsive collaborators who prefer being looped in once details are ready so they can align timing and handoff steps.
Vik appears to be waiting on a finalized plan and is ready to restate or relay the full repair-drive details once Rey confirms them.
Rey is the main coordinator, consistently promising to pass along details and keep others updated.
Vik relies on Rey to confirm the repair-drive plan once the final details are set.
Pia and Cleo are both helping keep the repair effort organized by monitoring deadlines and keeping supplies or instructions ready.

events.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I may be a bit forgetful, but I’m happy to help out however I can.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. I’ll let you know what needs doing.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Oren: Just point me to the first thing that needs fixing, and I’ll do my best. If I forget, feel free to remind me!
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I appreciate you looking out — I’ll let you know if I hear anything else.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Ira: Of course — just wave me down if anything changes.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Hana — I’ll let you know what needs doing.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — I’ll wait for your update and then I’ll confirm the details.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll sort out the details and get back to you soon.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — I’m keeping track of the drop-off spot and who’s covering each street, so I can organize it all cleanly.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal — that really helps. I’ll keep you posted if I hear about any other repairs.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Opal: Great, Rey — just send them my way and I’ll keep the list updated.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye — I’ll keep you posted if I hear about any other repairs.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll check our pickup timing and send you a window that works for us.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye — that works for me. I’ll wait for your timing window and pass it along.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Dane — I’ll sort out the details and get back to you soon.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Dane: Perfect — send it over when you can, and I’ll line everything up at the drop-off spot.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Rey: Will do — I’ll send the details over soon.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll keep you posted if I hear about any other repairs.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Vik: Thanks — just keep me posted, and I’ll repeat the full repair-drive plan once the details are set.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll sort out the details and let you know as soon as I have them.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Pia: I’m still steering people to the shed at 9 a.m., with the noon cutoff so nothing gets missed.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll keep pointing folks to the shed at 9 and make sure they know about the noon cutoff.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’ll keep doing the same and make sure no one misses the cutoff.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Cleo: I’ve still got some spare tools and tape ready, and I’ll keep watching for anything else that’s missing.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo — that really helps. I’ll keep you posted if I hear about any other repairs.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Cleo: Sounds good — send me any new repair needs, and I’ll keep the tools and tape ready.
events.speaker: Cleo
